items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: Yeah, that was Billy Phillip. And, uh, he had, uh, he had that place that, he had a place up in, in the Tender Line

ctx.x: Across the street from the entertainers on Franklin Street. Was that Billy Phillips? Billy Phillips.

Place? Billy Phillips. Billy Phillips. Billy Phillips on, on, on, that was on, on Franklin. Yeah, between Ivville and Bimble on the left-hand side. Yeah. Yeah, he had a place there, too, yeah. But he didn't have much of a dancing place there, you know. Like a hall and a ball. And they had two entrances, see. One entrance around on, on, on, on, uh, uh, Liberty Street. Isn't that Liberty? Uh, let's see, there's Franklin. And, yeah, Liberty. Liberty. Liberty. They had, they had a sort of an alley. Yeah. Liberty.…
